details: Current V2 render is a technical preview using heuristic SVG/icon compositions, not publish-grade scene assets. Read-only Higgsfield preflight on 2026-08-08 found free plan, 0 credits, expired free trial, and no unlimited generations; generating the required scene art there would consume paid credits. No other configured no-cost publish-grade visual provider is available. Preserve QA fail-closed and do not regenerate until a no-cost/included provider or owner-approved credits exist.
